First Woman to Play at Lord's Cricket Ground

The first woman to play a test match at the Lord's cricket ground, Crati Goud, made history by becoming the first woman to be named on the Lords' Honours Board. This achievement marks a significant milestone in women's cricket and comes after years of facing discrimination and marginalization. The recognition is seen as a step towards promoting equality and respect for women in sports.
